children: CEO Eduardo Chedid to lead fireside chat; PicPay to host lunch on Brazil’s next chapter in real-world AI

will participate in Money 20/20 USA on Monday, October 19, 2026, in Las Vegas, Nevada. PicPay senior leadership, including CEO Eduardo Chedid, CFO Andre Cazotto, EVP SMB Renata Greco, and EVP Audience and Ecosystem Alexandre Moshe will participate in sessions including a fireside chat and a hosted lunch featuring a discussion on connected banking and the practical use of AI in financial services.
Fireside chat: “Brazil Figured Out First: Connected Banking Experience.”

From 11:10 to 11:30 a.m. PT on The Intersection Stage, PicPay CEO Eduardo Chedid will join Candelaria Villagra, Head of Banking as a Service at BIND. The conversation will highlight how Pix and Open Finance transformed the financial landscape in Brazil and what other markets can learn from the country’s legacy of innovation.
Hosted lunch: “Beyond Pix: Brazil’s Next Chapter in Real-World AI.”

From 1:00 to 2:00 p.m. PT at Marco Polo 702, Venetian Ballrooms Level 1, The Venetian Las Vegas, Chedid will join Giancarlo Greco, CEO of Elo; Nilesh Dusane, Global Head of Institutional Payments at AWS; and Ana Carla Abrao, CEO of Open Finance Brasil. PicPay CFO Andre Cazotto will moderate. The discussion will explore where AI is useful today across customer experience, payments, Open Finance and financial services, what may come next as AI moves from providing information toward helping customers take action, and the importance of trust and customer control. For event information and registration

PicPay is one of the largest digital banks in Brazil by number of customers. The company operates a two-sided ecosystem creating a bridge between both consumers and businesses. PicPay offers a broad array of financial products and services such as digital wallet, credit cards, loans, investments, and insurance to consumers and businesses. For more information, please visit: https://investor.picpay.com/.
